items.title: Self-Driving & Self-Balancing Bicycle
items.text: Welcome to the official research and documentation repository for our student project at KU Leuven Campus Gent (Academic Year 2026–2027).

items.title: Project Overview
items.text: Building upon the success of a previous project, where our predecessors engineered a self-balancing bicycle utilizing drone motors and a custom remote control, our team has been tasked with reevaluating, refining, and expanding the system's capabilities.

items.title: Key Objectives & Enhancements
items.text:
We are taking the project a step further by introducing advanced autonomous features: - GPS Trajectory Control: Enabling autonomous navigation along predefined routes. - Obstacle Detection: Implementing sensors and algorithms to identify and avoid hazards in real time. - [TODO: Add more features]

Some of these advanced features are being developed in close collaboration with the ICT engineering students of our faculty.

items.title: Repository Contents
items.text: In this repository, you will find our comprehensive research, technical documentation, design schematics, and the code used in this project.
